decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY changing enable_gpio from GPIO3 to GPIO5, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Changing the switched 5V rail enable GPIO does not alter the standalone USB 3.3V LDO behavior or its powered scope.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing method, participating sources, or source-selection behavior.
The charge-status LED remains assigned to GPIO13 and is unaffected by reassignment of the separate 5V_EN signal.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording 5V_EN on GPIO5, SCL0 on GPIO38, and SPI MOSI on GPIO26.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not change the battery connector, pin functions, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
The interboard signal remains named 5V_EN on the connector; changing the ESP32 GPIO driving that net does not change the connector pinout or link architecture.
The GPIO reassignment for controlling the 5V rail does not change the LED board's count or addressable-LED type.
Moving SCL0 to another ESP32 GPIO does not alter the I2C bus speed, cable-length limit, pull-up configuration, or series-resistor policy.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not affect the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or VSYS labeling.
The GPIO reassignment does not change battery protection, cutoff thresholds, or the selected additional protection mode.
The 5V_EN GPIO reassignment does not alter battery temperature sensing through the J_BAT NTC connection.
